statement: At least one commercial vessel is struck by a mine, missile, or drone in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if a UKMTO incident advisory plus two of Reuters, AP, or Lloyds List Intelligence record a commercial vessel damaged by mine, missile, or drone in that area, incident dated 2026-09-03 through 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman sustains mine, missile, or drone damage during 2026-09-03 through 2026-09-30.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 110.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 95.33 on the packet date 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Brent front-month official settlement price equals or exceeds 110.00 on any trading day from 2026-09-03 through 2026-10-30. Reference level 95.33 at seal.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement from 2026-09-03 through 2026-10-30 prints below 110.00 USD per barrel.

statement: The US Treasury 10-year constant maturity par yield closes at or above 5.15 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-03 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 4.80 percent on 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 or the Treasury daily par yield curve records a 10-year value of 5.15 or higher on any date from 2026-09-03 through 2026-11-30. Reference 4.80 at seal.
failure_condition: The DGS10 series maximum across 2026-09-03 through 2026-11-30 stays below 5.15 percent.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one SonicWall vulnerability with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry with vendorProject SonicWall and dateAdded from 2026-09-03 through 2026-10-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog holds no SonicWall entry with a dateAdded inside that range when fetched at the deadline.

statement: The HHS Office for Civil Rights breach portal lists an Aesto Health breach affecting 9,500,000 or more individuals, posted between 2026-09-03 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the HHS OCR breach portal shows a single entry naming Aesto Health with individuals affected of 9,500,000 or more and a submission date in that window.
failure_condition: No single OCR portal entry naming Aesto Health reaches 9,500,000 individuals affected within that posting window.

statement: The US Department of Justice unseals a federal criminal charge over bulk sale of US drivers license data, filed between 2026-09-03 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if a justice.gov release plus a PACER docket show a federal indictment, information, or complaint charging bulk drivers license data sale, filed within that window.
failure_condition: No federal charging document alleging bulk US drivers license data sale carries a filing date inside that window.

statement: A lapse in federal appropriations begins between 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-30, triggering furloughs of non-excepted US federal employees.
resolution: TRUE if OMB or OPM published guidance, plus two of Reuters, AP, or Politico, record furloughs from an appropriations lapse commencing 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Federal appropriations remain continuously enacted through 2026-11-30 with no furlough-triggering lapse.

statement: Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin meet in person between 2026-09-03 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if two of Reuters, AP, or AFP report that the two principals met face to face at a named venue on a date from 2026-09-03 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No face-to-face Trump-Putin meeting occurs on any date in that window.

statement: Russian official sources confirm UAV interception or debris over Moscow city or Moscow oblast on at least three separate calendar days between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if Russian Ministry of Defence or Moscow mayoral statements, echoed by Reuters or AFP, name three or more distinct dates in that window with UAV interception over Moscow.
failure_condition: Fewer than three distinct calendar days in that window carry an official Russian UAV interception claim over Moscow.

statement: A UN OCHA or Nepal NDRRMA report published between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-15 states a confirmed death toll of 1,500 or more from the 2026 Nepal-Tibet floods.
resolution: TRUE if an OCHA situation report on ReliefWeb or an NDRRMA bulletin, published in that window, states 1,500 or more confirmed deaths from the 2026 Nepal flood event.
failure_condition: Every OCHA or NDRRMA report published in that window states a confirmed toll below 1,500.
